text: Affinity guides the choice, while capacity determines which choices are legal. Contraction changes the graph, so every later decision must use updated information. A legal partition, reaching the target, and global optimality are three different outcomes. The five-node example comes from Yongfu Li's E D A learning course. This lesson adds new explanations, narration, bilingual captions, and reproducible exercises.
